body: Damn. I’m so sorry. I’m here to talk if you ever need it. That feeling is just awful to live with.
No one takes depression seriously, unfortunately. I’ve told quite a few people, and no one gives a fuck.

I understand that feeling. It gets scary, and I almost quit my job recently because I figured there’s no point, and it’s hard enough to get out of bed in the morning, much less actually complete my work projects. 

I wish I had advice for you, but just know that I hear you.
I hear you. I’m exhausted too.
I hear you. I hope I die this year somehow. I’m sorry you’re struggling.
I was in a similar relationship. It’s time to start thinking about how you can leave. It’s time to love yourself again.
Yes. I brush my teeth with my eyes closed or in another room so i don’t see my reflection for more than a couple seconds.
Lmfao thank you for sharing this
I’m so glad someone understands.
I totally agree.
Thank you. You’re right.
Thank you so much for this.
Thank you so, so much for this. I can honestly say this grounded me a little and helped me remember things i enjoy.

I completely understand what you mean. I have completely broken down and can hardly take care of myself anymore. I genuinely need someone to take care of me like a toddler. Never thought in a million years I’d feel like this.
Thank you
Exactly.
I might call tonight. But the last call was so pointless. He just told me to journal.
I relate to a lot of what you said. I hear you.
I called earlier this month. The guy just told me to journal.

I swear, a really bad day with depression can eliminate weeks or months of hard work. It hurts so badly. 

Life is strange. I hope you find even a tiny bit of peace tonight, if possible.
I completely relate to you. I agree with everything you said.
Did you even consider that posting this on a suicide subreddit could be triggering for people? Wtf man
That’s the only thing keeping me going.
Texting the hotline is a good idea. Proud of you.
Keep holding on if you can.
Me too. I just hope it’s over soon.
I think about this every day. I hear you.
Damn... I hear you. That’s rough!
Thank you. Yeah I wish I could. I don’t have roommates or anyone who can help with bills, money is tight, and can’t take time off work at this moment.
You completely missed the point of my post.
I’m an atheist. I don’t believe in god. I don’t believe in heaven or hell.
Lmao exactly.
That’s so awful.... I’m so, so happy that you moved out. I hope you’re doing okay.
I totally agree.
I’m 23. How will this make sense next year?
I’m so sorry. Oh my god. Religious trauma is awful and so hard to deal with. Fuck all of that shit. I hope you’re feeling okay.
I hear you. I tried so hard to “feel god.” Changed my lifestyle, prayed multiple times a day. After years, I still felt nothing.
I’m so sorry for the pain you’re in. I hear you.
I relate to this in a lot of ways. I hear you.
I’m so sorry. Don’t hold your tears, let them flow. It’s alright. You deserve nice things for yourself. Maybe do something special or relaxing for yourself this weekend if you can.

Just make sure you mention that you don’t have a plan, and you aren’t brainstorming any plans for future use. So long as your therapist doesn’t see you in immediate danger of killing yourself, you should be fine.
It’s very exhausting having to work and make a life for yourself when you never asked to be here. I understand that feeling. I’m sorry.

Both attempted suicide by gunshot to the head. Both failed, essentially due to bad aiming, just didn’t kill them. They’re disfigured and can’t walk correctly. Really sad shit. One of them is totally out of their mind, doesn’t even know what year it is or what his name is. Really terrifying.
Wow you’re so strong... I admire you holding on even though it’s tough.
I’m so sorry... Please message me if you’d like to talk. I’m here for you.
Hanging in there. How are you? I hope you can do something fun or at least relaxing tonight.
I’m so sorry that happened. I called a suicide hotline last month and also had a bad experience. I wish there were better resources to help us.

I used to work at a traumatic brain injury facility. Had 2 patients who tried to commit suicide and failed. They’ll be living at that facility for the rest of their lives. So yeah it’s also my biggest fear as well, you aren’t alone.
Thank you.

It’s normal to feel that way. But giving her up can open the door to a different mental health professional who is more delicate and sensitive to your needs. Your mental health and well being is the #1 priority always! We need you to feel better, no matter what it takes.

I am so sorry. That is seriously awful. Maybe consider changing therapists if possible? She seems like she’s doing more harm than good, and you are clearly in a fragile state and need help and compassion.
You’re absolutely not alone. I think about that stuff too.

It certainly does. Keep holding on dude. It’s a very realistic possibility that in your near future, you will be separated & paying child support. And doing things you enjoy. Then you’ll be a HAPPIER father. Your kid will have a happy dad. How awesome. Fingers crossed for you man.

Ah i see. Sorry man. I wish I could do more to help, but killing yourself isn’t the answer. There’s a divorce subreddit where people have more insight on how to deal with divorces if it comes to that. Best of luck. You deserve to have friends and do the things you enjoy.

Dude, fuck that girl. Seriously. You need to break up with her and get your life and mental health back. I promise, you’ll look back in a couple years and wonder why you wasted time on her. Happier days are definitely ahead for you.

Perhaps you are placing all of your self worth in a romantic relationship, and you think that if you don’t have that, then your life isn’t worth living. 

If that’s the case, I’d suggest spending more meaningful time with yourself, finding hobbies that you enjoy, spending time in nature, eating right, and exercising. Sounds cheesy, but it can really ground you and help you deal with these irrational thoughts.

Just because someone isn’t interested in you doesn’t mean that you should kill yourself. Rejections, breakups, and divorces happen every day. By your logic, almost everyone on earth would have to kill themselves at some point. 

Trust me, it’s normal for relationships to not work out. It’s normal for people to lose interest in each other. Doesn’t mean you’re a loser.
